name: Osaka Soda Co., Ltd.
summary: Osaka Soda Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells basic and functional chemicals products in Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company provides caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, liquid chlorine, chlorine gas, sodium hypochlorite, sodium chlorite, sodium chlorate, caustic potash, hydrogen gas, epichlorohydrin, allyl chloride, etc. It also offers Allyl Ethers; EPICHLOMER, an epichlorohydrin rubber; RACRESTER acrylic rubber; DAISO DAP, a diallyl phthalates; RADPAR, a non-phthalate allyl resin; CABRUS, polysulfide silane coupling agent; and electrodes, etc. In addition, the company provides silica gel for HPLC DAISOGEL; analytical equipment; CAPCELL PAK, HPLC column; active pharmace…
